images.text: Vendor: Once this software license agreement is signed by you, we'll be allowed to move on to the acceptance testing.

Vendor: The acceptance testing phase. A procedure which allows you to test the licensed software to verify that it meets the specified requirements. This is a very important step because you, as the consumer of the product, need to test it and ensure that it is what you need and that you can use it properly.
Tom: I see! I had some problems before with another piece of software because I hadn't run any test like this.
Vendor: I've heard that many times. The last client I talked to had purchased software with no license and wanted us to perform an acceptance test for him. He wanted someone to help him.
Tom: Can you get help for this kind of testing?

Vendor: Sure! This procedure can be a collaborative process, with the customer being assisted by the vendor, which would be me in this case. The customer has to give the software vendor written notifications of the deficiencies found during the testing, so he can correct them and resubmit the software for further testing.
Tom: So, I have to let the vendor know whether the software passes or fails the acceptance testing?
Vendor: That's right. Last semester, we had some problems because some of the purchasers hadn't complied with this requirement and some defective software ended up in stores.

Vendor: Well, if the testing procedure is successful, there may be a payment milestone or other consequences like the commencement of a limited warranty period. However, if there is a failure, the customer receives compensation. He can either cancel the software license purchased and receive a refund of prepaid fees, or negotiate revisions to the acceptance criteria.

The past perfect tense is used to talk about actions in the past that happened before another action.
I had some problems before with another software because I hadn't run any test like this.
Last semester, we had some problems because some of the purchasers hadn't complied with this requirement and some defective software ended up in stores.

When we want to express two actions that happened at different times in the past, we use the past perfect tense to talk about the first action, and the simple past tense to talk about the second action. Let's take a look at the basic structure and an example:

Acceptance Testing is the phase of software testing when a software tool is tested for acceptability. The objective of such a test is to assess the system's conformity with business needs and to evaluate whether it is acceptable for release.
